joss_title: MarSwitching.jl: A Julia package for Markov switching dynamic models

title: "MarSwitching.jl: Markov switching dynamic models in Julia"
abstract: >-
  MarSwitching.jl is a Julia package for estimating Markov switching dynamic
  models, also known as regime switching models. It supports k regimes with
  independently switching or non-switching intercept, variance and covariates,
  time-varying transition probabilities, Markov switching ARCH, non-Gaussian
  error distributions, and filtered and smoothed regime probabilities.
